title: Filesystem check-then-use race in a privileged shell workflow
preconditions: A path is tested/stat'ed and later opened, renamed, removed, or executed
dangerous_transitions: A path is tested/stat'ed and later opened, renamed, removed, or executed
sink_semantics: test/[[ -e ]]/stat followed by redirection, cp, mv, rm, chmod, or execution
counterevidence: Check whether an attacker can replace a path component or symlink between check and use; quoting alone does not prevent races.
verification_recipe: Trace the language-specific source cue to test/[[ -e ]]/stat followed by redirection, cp, mv, rm, chmod, or execution.
Establish attacker control, effective principal, guarding order, and security impact.
